decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - If within a period of five years from the date of the planting of any tree or shrub, that tree or shrub, or any tree or shrub planted in replacement for it, is removed, uprooted or destroyed or dies, (or becomes, in the opinion of the local planning authority, seriously damaged or defective,) another tree or shrub of the same species and size as that originally planted shall be planted at the same place, unless the local planning authority gives its written consent to any variation.
description: Details of landscaping, window specification, and contamination submitted pursuant to conditions 7 and 10 and part A and B of condition 11 of planning permission 00639/117A/P3 dated 28/08/2015 for the part demolition of existing building and creation of a office space on ground floor and four apartments on ground, first and second floors. Erection of a new three storey building comprising a pair of semi-detached houses.
